theater: 燕雲十六州與遼五京道

battle.name: 宋金滅遼
battle.theater: 燕雲十六州與遼五京道
battle.brief: 宣和二年起，女真金與北宋聯手攻遼：宋將童貫自河北率軍北伐，金兵連取上京、中京，宋軍終得燕京；五年之間遼廷北奔，耶律延禧被俘，耶律大石西走建西遼。弩是宋遼金三軍的骨幹火力，機括十字弩與神臂弓在城頭居高壓制，野戰則因裝填遲緩而難敵騎兵衝鋒。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 本役三方：遼朝、金朝、北宋。遼為契丹人所建，五京並立——上京臨潢府、中京大定府、南京幽州（燕京）、西京雲中，另有東京黃龍府；天祚帝耶律延禧在位而威權不集中，攝政蕭綽早於天會元年病故，政事落到近支皇族與南北面官手上。遼軍由契丹部落兵、漢人州縣募兵、奚與渤海部眾拼成，契丹兵尚武而漢軍重器械，攻守之際並非單一體系。金朝方面，一一四年末完顏阿骨打起兵於寧江州，一一五年建大金於會寧府，太祖阿骨打以猛安謀克制女真，鐵騎為骨幹，收降遼境漢軍與契丹舊部之後另編漢軍；一二二三年太宗完顏吳乞買嗣位，都元帥完顏杲統大軍西征，西路完顏宗翰（漢名粘罕）與東路完顏宗望（漢名撻懶）先後領兵。宋方由宣和朝文臣武將共掌：宰相蔡京主政，童貫以太師開府領河北燕京宣撫使，蔡攸為副，樞密院與禁軍在後，河北、河東兩路兵馬分屯待命，並許諾由海道出兵策應；宋以海上之盟為紐帶，條款無第三方監督，全憑信義維繫。
countriesEn: Three parties took part in this campaign: the Liao dynasty, the Jin dynasty and the Northern Song. The Liao, founded by the Khitan, kept five capitals in parallel: Shangjing Linhuang, Zhongjing Dading, Nanjing Youzhou (Yanjing), Xijing Yungong, and Dongjing Huanglong. Liao Tianzuo, Emperor Yelu Yanxi, sat on the throne without holding effective authority; the regent Xiao Chuo had died of illness before the first year of Tianhui, and government passed to the near branches of the imperial clan and to the dual system of northern and southern administration. The Liao army was pieced together from Khitan tribal levies, Han Chinese militia recruited by prefecture and county, and Xian and Bohai contingents: the Khitan were the martial element, the Han units leaned on equipment, and the two were never a single system. On the Jin side, Wanyan Aguda raised troops at Ningjiang prefecture at the end of 1114 and founded the Great Jin at Huining in 1115. The founder Aguda organised the Jurchen in the meng'an mouke, with armoured cavalry as the backbone, and after taking over Han troops and former Khitan contingents inside Liao territory he enrolled them separately as a Han army. In 1123 Taizong Wanyan Wugimai succeeded him; the commander-in-chief Wanyan Gao led the great army westward, while the western commander Wanyan Zonghan (Chinese name Nihan) and the eastern commander Wanyan Zongwang (Chinese name Talen) took charge in turn. On the Song side, civil officials and generals of the Xuanhe court held command jointly: the chancellor Cai Jing governed, Tong Guan led the Hebei-Yanjing Pacification Commission as Grand Preceptor with an open commission, and Cai You served as his deputy, with the Privy Council and the imperial guards behind them; troops of the Hebei and Hedong circuits stood ready in separate columns, and the Song undertook to attack by sea in support. The two sides were bound by the Alliance Made at Sea, whose clauses had no third party to enforce them and rested entirely on good faith.
people: 完顏阿骨打是本役的起點人物。他起兵時所部不過數千，一一五年建國為金太祖，一一七年取黃龍府，一二二三年八月病逝於會寧府，帝位由弟完顏吳乞買（太宗）承繼。太宗在位時以完顏杲為都元帥西征，完顏宗翰、完顏宗望分統西路東路，最終攻入中京大定府，追捕北奔的耶律延禧；宗翰與宗望此後便是攻宋的同一批人。遼方主角是耶律延禧，他一一〇一年即位，放棄斡闊裡禁地，與兄耶律淳爭位而失人心，國勢在他手裡節節敗退；攝政蕭綽是更早一代的關鍵人物，她的南面行朝與重農之政曾把遼國推到巔峰，但一一〇七年南巡病故，此後再無能壓住皇族與藩鎮爭端的能臣。耶律大石在遼廷崩解前率部西走，一二二四年在虎思斡耳朵另建西遼，把契丹統治帶到西域，與宋金在中原的爭奪脫鉤。宋方主持者為童貫、蔡京、蔡攸：童貫主持河北軍事，與金議盟並兩次北伐；蔡京以財賦支撐北伐；蔡攸居中樞司。馬植是促成海上之盟的關鍵中間人，他以宋人身份兩度赴金，後因受金人財賄被貶逐。宣和四年降宋的遼將郭藥師，在宣和七年收復燕京時為先鋒；宣和七年五月平州將領張覺降宋，則成了金人攻宋的藉口。
peopleEn: Wanyan Aguda was the figure from which this campaign begins. When he first raised troops he had barely a few thousand men; he founded the state in 1115 as Jin Taizu, took Huanglong prefecture in 1117, and died of illness at Huining in the eighth month of 1123, leaving the throne to his brother Wanyan Wugimai, Taizong. Under Taizong the commander-in-chief Wanyan Gao led the great army westward, while Wanyan Zonghan and Wanyan Zongwang took charge of the western and eastern columns, and in the end broke into Zhongjing Dading and hunted down Yelu Yanxi as he fled north; the same two men would shortly lead the war against Song. The central figure on the Liao side was Yelu Yanxi, who took the throne in 1101, abandoned the Wanyeledeli forbidden uplands, lost the affection of the people in his struggle with his elder brother Yelu Chun, and watched the state fall away piece by piece under his own hand. The regent Xiao Chuo belonged to an earlier generation and was just as decisive: her administration from the southern capital and her agrarian policies had carried the Liao to its height, but she died of illness on a southern tour in 1107, and after that there was no longer anyone able to hold down the quarrels between the imperial clan and the regional houses. Yelu Dashi led a force west before the Liao court dissolved and founded the Western Liao at Husigaolu in 1124, carrying Khitan rule into Central Asia and cutting it loose from the contest between Song and Jin in the Central Plains. On the Song side the men in charge were Tong Guan, Cai Jing and Cai You: Tong Guan directed the military affairs of Hebei, negotiated the alliance with Jin and led the two northern expeditions; Cai Jing supplied the money that paid for them; and Cai You handled the business of the Privy Council. Ma Zhi was the intermediary who brought the Alliance Made at Sea about, travelling to Jin twice in a Song official's capacity and later being demoted for taking Jin's money. The Liao general Guo Yaoshi, who came over to Song in 1124, led the van in the recovery of Yanjing in 1125; and the surrender of the Pingzhou commander Zhang Jue in the fifth month of 1125 gave the Jin a pretext for the war against Song.
kits: 卡面這件十字弩，落在本役的體系裡是「守城骨架、野戰短板」的那一端。宋軍弩兵之源出《武經總要》所載編制：強弩居前，槊手與長刀兵在後掩護，弩手以器械絞張、腳踏上弦，一輪齊射之後退回陣中重新裝填；宋人又把這條路推到極處，出現了張力更大的神臂弓與蹶張弓，張弦需人踩蹶張機。遼軍亦備弩，守燕京與中京時以弩手分佈城垛與敵樓射孔之間；金軍則以弓為主，女真騎兵用角弓，遊牧出身的射手不習重型弩機，故弩在金軍中多由收編的漢軍與降附的遼人操作。攻城一方在弩火之下最難受：宋軍攻遼用雲梯、撞竿與壕車，梯車接近城牆的一刻全靠弩手封住垛口；遼人守城以檑木、沸水、落石配弓弩覆蓋，形成「先以矢石壓制、再以長兵登城」的固定次第。卡面所屬的歐洲弩族同源機括，在十一、十二世紀的歐洲以絞盤弩立於城頭，靠弩手與長弓手搭配守城，與宋、遼、金三國的十字弩屬同一技術家族，但歐洲的重型弩配甲騎兵於開闊地，東方十字弩配輕騎與步卒於水網山地，分量不同。弩的射程與貫穿力足以在城頭壓制披甲騎兵，但要壓住密集騎兵的衝鋒，仍須弓作連續覆蓋；裝填的緩慢，使它在野戰中永遠只能當作掩護火力，而不是決定性的一擊。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the card sits in the system of this campaign on the side of the firm backbone of siege defence and the weak point of field work. The Song crossbow troops came from the organisation recorded in the Wujing Zongyao: heavy crossbows in front, spear and long-knife infantry behind them as cover, the crossbow men winding the bow by machine and setting the string with the foot, then withdrawing into the formation to reload after a salvo; the Song pushed this line to its limit and produced the stronger shenbi bows and the cuzhang bows, whose strings had to be drawn with the foot on a treadle frame. The Liao kept crossbows too, and when defending Yanjing and Zhongjing the crossbow men were distributed between the crenellations and the arrow slits of the towers. The Jin leaned on the bow: Jurchen cavalry used composite bows, and horsemen raised on the steppe were not trained on heavy crossbow machines, so in Jin service the crossbow was largely worked by Han troops and by Liao deserters who had joined. The side attacking was the one in most pain under that fire. The Song attacked Liao positions with scaling ladders, battering rams and gangways, and the instant a ladder gangway came up against the wall the whole business depended on crossbow men sealing the crenels. The Liao answered with logs, boiling water and stones thrown down, covered by bows and crossbows, in a fixed sequence: first suppression by missile and stone, then the assault with long weapons. The European family to which the card's crossbow belongs shares the same trigger mechanism; in eleventh and twelfth century Europe the windlass crossbow was set up on the wall and the defence was run by crossbow men working with longbow men, so it belongs to the same technological family as the Chinese crossbow of Song, Liao and Jin. The weight was distributed differently: the heavy European crossbow was paired with armoured cavalry in open country, the eastern crossbow with light cavalry and infantry amid water and hills. The range and penetration of the crossbow were enough to dominate armoured horsemen from a wall, but to hold off a dense charge of horsemen the bow still had to lay down continuous covering fire; and because reloading is slow, in the open field it could only ever be covering fire and never the decisive blow.
tactics: 滅遼是一場高屋建瓴加分割殲滅。金的策略是先取東北的馬牛之地（黃龍府、會寧府），再直搗契丹族地：遼廷放棄上京臨潢府而退保中京，京畿與京西兩路援軍被金軍以騎兵切斷，途中屢屢被各個擊破；耶律延禧出逃時，連留守的漢官與部將都無法節制，只帶數百隨從北走，最終在極北之地被金軍攔截。一二二四年耶律大石率眾西走，在西域另立西遼，等於把遼的西部從中京割出去，使金不必再分兵。宋的戰法與金不同：其策略不是野戰決勝，而是以龐大兵力輪番逼近、以糧道與城邑為依託，河北一路由童貫自雄州北上，河東一路以老將種師道為帥攻朔州；宋軍聲勢雖大，卻屢屢受制於糧運與遼軍游騎，攻城器械的往返與水運的調度拖慢節奏，第一次北伐終在宣和三年春不戰自退，第二次北伐則在宣和七年正月收復燕京。器械層面上，弩決定了攻城與守城的節奏：攻城方需先用壕車抵近城牆、以撞竿擊門樓，再以長兵登城，而這一段時間正是弩手最脆弱的時刻，故須以雲梯群同時壓上多處垛口以分散守軍火力；守方以弩手輪替覆蓋，射界分段的垛口配重弩，一段封死即換下一段。守城方真正吃虧的不是射程，而是弩的裝填間隔被人看穿。
tacticsEn: The destruction of Liao was a war of high-level strategy combined with annihilation by separation. The Jin plan was to take first the horse and cattle lands of the north-east, Huanglong prefecture and Huining, and then to strike straight at the Khitan homeland. The Liao court abandoned Shangjing Linhuang and fell back on Zhongjing; the relief armies from the capital region and from the west were cut off by Jin cavalry and beaten in detail on the way; and when Yelu Yanxi fled north, neither the Han officials who stayed behind nor his generals could hold things together, so he went with a few hundred followers and was finally intercepted by Jin troops in the far north. In 1124 Yelu Dashi led his people west and founded the Western Liao in Central Asia, which cut the western part of Liao away from Zhongjing and meant the Jin no longer had to divide its forces. The Song method was different from the Jin method. Its plan was not to win a field battle but to advance by turns with enormous numbers and to lean on supply lines and walled seats: the Hebei column went north under Tong Guan from Xiongzhou, and the Hedong column went at Shuozhou under the old general Zhong Shidao. The Song army was impressive in size, yet it was repeatedly held up by supply and by Liao raiding parties; the turning round of siege equipment and the movement of grain by water slowed the tempo, and the first northern expedition came to an end of its own accord in the spring of Xuanhe 3, while the second recovered Yanjing in the first month of Xuanhe 7. At the level of equipment, the crossbow set the tempo of siege and defence. The attacking side had to bring gangways up to the wall first, strike the gates and towers with rams, and only then send long weapons up; and that stretch of time was precisely when the crossbow men were most exposed, so ladders had to be brought up against several crenel sectors at once to spread the defenders' fire. On the defending side the crossbow men covered in rotation, heavy bows being posted to the sectors of the wall, and a sector sealed off was abandoned in favour of the next. What actually cost the defenders was not the range of the crossbow but the fact that the interval between reloads could be read.
data: 可用的數字大致如下，多為宋、金、遼三方官修史書的概數，彼此常有出入。寧江州之戰，金兵不足三千對遼軍號稱七萬，先敗後勝，是女真起家的第一戰；阿骨打建金時所部亦只數萬之眾。建國之後，金取黃龍府（一一七年）、取遼上京臨潢府（一二〇年）、取中京大定府（一二五年），遼亡共歷約五年。宋的北伐兵數史稱二十萬，另有記載作十五萬上下：宣和二年出師時分河北、河東兩路，宣和七年收復燕京時再集二十萬。地理尺度上，金上京會寧府（今吉林農安）至遼中京大定府（今內蒙古寧城）直線約一千一百里，中京至燕京約五百六十里，燕京至汴京約一千三百里；金軍自會寧府直趨中京，騎兵行程以旬計。宋軍的極限在糧：以一人一日二斤的常額計，二十萬人每日需糧數十萬斤，河北線運糧須經海河、霸州分運，倉場一破，前線即潰，所以第一次北伐最大的障礙不是遼軍的城牆，而是運糧的距離。遼廷北走時，耶律延禧隨行者僅數百人；西遷的耶律大石所部則有數千。西遼一系延續到十三世紀初葉方為蒙古所滅，比遼的正統多延續九十年以上。
dataEn: The usable figures are roughly as follows; they are mostly round numbers from the official histories of Song, Jin and Liao, and they often disagree with one another. At the battle of Ningjiang, fewer than three thousand Jurchen faced a Liao army numbered at seventy thousand, lost first and then won, and that was the first battle that made the Jurchen; when Aguda founded the state he had no more than a few tens of thousands of men. After the foundation, the Jin took Huanglong prefecture in 1117, took Liao Shangjing Linhuang in 1120 and took Zhongjing Dading in 1125, so that the fall of Liao took about five years. The size of the Song northern armies is given in the histories as two hundred thousand, with other accounts putting it nearer one hundred and fifty thousand: in the second year of Xuanhe the army went out in Hebei and Hedong columns, and in the seventh year of Xuanhe the two hundred thousand were mustered again for the recovery of Yanjing. As to distances, Jin Shangjing Huining (present Ning'an in Jilin) stands about eleven hundred li in a straight line from Liao Zhongjing Dading (present Ningcheng in Inner Mongolia), Zhongjing is about five hundred and sixty li from Yanjing, and Yanjing about one thousand three hundred li from Bianjing; the Jin cavalry rode straight from Huining on Zhongjing, and the journey was reckoned in tens of days. The limit of the Song army lay in grain. On the common allowance of two jin a man a day, two hundred thousand men needed several hundred thousand jin of grain every day, and the Hebei line had to move it by sea and river through Bazhou, so that once a depot was lost the front collapsed. The greatest obstacle to the first northern expedition was therefore not the walls of Liao cities but the distance the grain had to travel. When the Liao court fled north, Yelu Yanxi had only a few hundred followers with him; the force that went west with Yelu Dashi numbered several thousand. The Western Liao line lasted until the early thirteenth century before the Mongols destroyed it, more than ninety years longer than the Liao proper.
cause: 滅遼有三層原因疊在一起。第一層是遼國內部的失衡：天祚帝耶律延禧放棄了契丹人視為根本的斡闊裡禁地，把牧地與都城讓給漢地州縣，自己在南京、中京之間來回遷徙，既傷了契丹貴族，又冷了漢人官員；與兄耶律淳的皇位爭執更裂開了契丹皇族，數十年間上京、中京、燕京三地各有派系，號令不能一統。第二層是金的興起：完顏阿骨打聚合完顏部，以寧江州之役破遼前鋒，奪黃龍府得其地產、馬群與鐵貨，兵源與糧秣自此充足；遼廷內鬥正給了他逐個擊破的機會。第三層是宋的介入：燕雲十六州自石晉割地以來一直是中原王朝的心病，徽宗朝以承繼先志、恢復燕雲為號召，童貫、蔡京一黨以聯金滅遼為捷徑，用歲幣換十六州；海上之盟以宋方由海道出兵的承諾作交換，宋卻沒有履行，金人由此看清楚宋廷空言無實，也看見燕雲一旦入手即可直窩中原。於是同一場戰役裡三方的算盤各自指向對方：宋要地，金要歲幣與屏障，遼要保住祖宗之地，卻沒有一方算得到代價會在三年之內由宋來付。
causeEn: Three causes are stacked on top of one another in the destruction of Liao. The first is the imbalance inside the Liao state. Liao Tianzuo, Yelu Yanxi, abandoned the Wanyeledeli forbidden uplands that the Khitan held to be their root, gave the pastures and the capital sites to Han prefectures and counties, and moved back and forth between Nanjing and Zhongjing himself, which wounded the Khitan aristocracy and cooled the Han officials. His struggle with his elder brother Yelu Chun over the throne split the Khitan imperial clan, and for decades Shangjing, Zhongjing and Yanjing each had their own faction, so that orders could not be made uniform. The second cause is the rise of the Jin. Wanyan Aguda gathered the Wanyan tribes, broke the Liao vanguard at Ningjiang, and took Huanglong prefecture with its land, its herds and its iron, after which manpower and provisions were no longer scarce; the infighting inside the Liao court gave him exactly the chance to defeat them one at a time. The third cause is the intervention of Song. The sixteen prefectures of Yanyun had been a running sore of the Central Plains dynasties since the Jin interregnum ceded them, and the court of Huizong raised the banner of carrying on the work of his ancestors and recovering Yanyun; Tong Guan and the party of Cai Jing took the alliance with Jin and the destruction of Liao as a shortcut, buying the sixteen prefectures with annual payments. The Alliance Made at Sea had the Song undertaking to attack by sea in support, and the Song never did it, so the Jin learned that the Song court talked empty, and also saw that once Yanyun were in hand it could look straight into the Central Plains. In the same war the three parties were all calculating against one another: Song wanted territory, Jin wanted payments and a buffer, Liao wanted to keep the lands of its ancestors, and not one of them had reckoned that the bill would fall on Song within three years.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果是三百年遼祚終結，真正改變格局的卻是連帶效果。遼亡之後，燕雲十六州入宋，宋朝北界從河北推到山海關與白溝河，北方屏障看似到手；然而經營燕雲所需的兵員、糧秣、驛傳與城防工程，遠超宣和朝可支配的財政與編制能力，宋廷倚重的是新降的幽州軍與河北諸路兵，戰鬥力與忠誠都靠不住。對金而言，遼亡是一場戰略與財政的雙重擴張：他們得到燕雲以北的屏障、遼人的降眾與漢地州縣的賦稅，戰兵與輜重來源大增，此後南下便再無後顧。海上之盟也在此役中耗盡信用，宋未履行海路出兵之約，金人南下攻宋，宋金之間從此只剩彼此防備。契丹人的去向尤為關鍵：耶律大石西遷建西遼，把契丹政權延續到西域近百年；另一支後人隨蒙古西征，耶律楚材入帳下，終成元朝的重要輔弼，契丹一族的歷史由是從中原轉向草原與西域。此外，此役之後宋金邊界再無中間地帶，宋失去從容整軍的時間，宣和七年到靖康二年的四年間，戰局由進攻轉為崩潰，成為北宋終結的直接原因。
impactEn: The direct result of this war was the end of three centuries of Liao, but what really changed the shape of the world was the chain of consequences. With Liao gone, the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun passed to Song, and the northern frontier of the dynasty moved from Hebei out to Shanhaiguan and the White Ditch, so that the northern buffer appeared to have been won. Yet the troops, provisions, courier stations and fortification works needed to hold Yanyun far exceeded the finance and the establishment that the Xuanhe court could command, and the Song relied on newly surrendered Liao troops and on the soldiers of the Hebei circuits, whose fighting power and loyalty were both unreliable. For the Jin, the fall of Liao was an expansion in both strategy and finance: they gained the buffer north of Yanyun, the surrendered Liao people, and the taxes of the Han prefectures, so that their supply of fighting men and transport grew sharply and they had no rear left to worry about when they marched south. The Alliance Made at Sea also spent all of its credit in this campaign. The Song had not honoured the undertaking to attack by sea; the Jin marched south against Song; and from then on there was nothing between the two states but mutual distrust. Where the Khitan went afterwards matters just as much. Yelu Dashi moved west and founded the Western Liao, carrying Khitan rule into Central Asia for close to a century; another branch of the family went west with the Mongols, and Yelü Chucai entered the tent and became an important minister of the Yuan, so that the history of the Khitan turned from the Central Plains towards the steppe and Central Asia. Beyond that, once this war was over there was no buffer left between Song and Jin, and Song lost the time in which to reorganise its armies. In the four years from Xuanhe 7 to Jingkang 2 the course of the war turned from advance to collapse, which was the direct cause of the end of the Northern Song.
result: 宣和七年（一二二五年）正月，宋軍入燕京，改置燕京府；同年二月金軍攻入中京大定府，遼廷崩解。耶律延禧北走，輾轉投奔部族，被金軍追獲，押送會寧府，其後遷至汴京，數年後死於南方，與南朝宗室同囚一地。耶律大石率部西去，在虎思斡耳朵立國，遼的西部與名號在那裡另續一支，與宋金的爭端再不相干。對宋而言，功業只算了一半：燕雲十六州到手，然而不到一年半，靖康元年金軍南下，燕京重陷，汴京不保，徽欽二帝北狩，宣和年間數次北伐最終換來國祚中斷。對金而言，此役是立國之後第一次大規模用兵，滅一國、得一地、得一批降眾、得一套漢地徵調與城防的經驗，戰力由此蛻變，數年後南下便再非建國初年那支只知劫掠的部眾可比。這場戰役留下的教訓落在器械與制度兩面：弩與任何機械火器在城頭可以製造壓倒性的一刻，卻決定不了遠方田界的歸屬；而以盟約換國土、以歲幣換戰爭的做法，後來被證明不可持續。
resultEn: In the first month of Xuanhe 7, that is 1125, the Song army entered Yanjing and the city was reorganised as the prefecture of Yanjing; in the second month of the same year the Jin army broke into Zhongjing Dading and the Liao court came apart. Yelu Yanxi fled north, fell in with tribes on the way, was hunted down and taken by the Jin, and was carried off to Huining, later transferred to Bianjing, where he died some years afterwards, held in the same captivity as the princes of the southern court. Yelu Dashi led his people west, founded a state at Husigaolu, and there the western part of Liao and its name were continued in another line, no longer involved in the quarrels of Song and Jin. For Song the achievement was only half: the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun were gained, yet in less than a year and a half the Jin marched south in the first year of Jingkang, Yanjing fell again, Bianjing could not be held, the two emperors Huizong and Qinzong were carried north, and the several northern expeditions of the Xuanhe years ended in the severance of the dynasty. For Jin this was the first large-scale use of an army since the foundation of the state: one country destroyed, one territory gained, a batch of surrendered people taken, and a set of experience in Han-style requisition and in fortification; the army changed character in the process, and when it marched south a few years later it was no longer the same body of raiders as in the early years. The lessons of this campaign lie on two sides, in equipment and in institutions: the crossbow, like any machine-powered missile, could create a moment of overwhelming superiority on a wall, but it could not decide the ownership of distant fields; and the practice of buying territory with alliances and buying war with annual payments was later shown not to be sustainable.
